The vendored duifene package is adapted from bytehola/duifene_auto_sign,
https://github.com/bytehola/duifene_auto_sign
revision 8f592d19de52b2a736eecf221961cb2ce888cdd4 (v1.1).
The upstream README declares MIT License.

Local adaptations: injectable encrypted storage; successful-read telemetry;
structured form encoding, three-state login-response validation and a cancellation guard for submissions. The local
application replaces the single-course GUI watcher with a shared, sequential
multi-course monitor and encrypted continuous-monitor preferences. The browser application, local
HTTP server and encrypted persistence are separate from the upstream GUI.
Local security adaptation for v0.6.0: configured proxies no longer disable
certificate verification. Legacy verify_tls=false settings are normalized to
verified HTTPS; SignalR negotiation and WSS enforce certificate/hostname checks.
Untrusted interception certificates fail safely instead of disabling TLS checks.
No upstream credentials, personal configuration or runtime data are included.
